name: anderson-2008-amplitude
citation: Anderson HA, Hentz G, Glasser A, Stuebing KK, Manny RE. Minus-lens-stimulated accommodative amplitude decreases sigmoidally with age: a study of objectively measured accommodative amplitudes from age 3. Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 49(7):2919-2926, 2008.
verificationNote: Equation and coefficients transcribed from the paper's abstract as indexed by the publisher (the sigmoid is fitted to the study's objective amplitudes for ages 3-40 pooled with earlier objective adult data up to age 70). Group means were not reachable in this session, so the test checks the equation against hand evaluations, not against tabled means.

domain.note: Spec §4.1 age range. Below minAgeYears the age-6 value is used; above maxAgeYears the amplitude is 0 (presbyopia; the fit is already below 0.01 D there). The study measured ages 3-40 and pooled adult data to 70, so 70-90 is an extrapolation of the fit.
